title: WiseOwl COBOL source listing, schema version 1.0
description: The source listing of one compilation: the source as read, with its COPY inclusions and programs. Lines are referred to by their listing line number and files by their id. Every format (text, JSON) renders this one document.

$schema.description: The identifier of the schema the document follows: urn:wiseowl:cobol:listing:v1 for every version of major 1.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version the document was written at, <major>.<minor>. A reader of major 1 reads every 1.x document and ignores the properties it does not know.

header.description: The compiler, the edition, the compilation timestamp, the main source and the outcome.

edition.description: The edition's year as --std spells it (85, 2002, 2014, 2023).

compiledAt.description: The compilation's one instant (DESIGN-listing.md section 5): the same instant WHEN-COMPILED and DATE-COMPILED's replacement denote.

mainSource.description: The path of the source file compiled.

outcome.description: How far the compilation got. Success: The assembly was written. FrontendError: The text stages or the parser refused the source. BindError: The binder refused the program. BackendError: The backend could not produce the assembly. OutputNotWritable: The source compiled, but the host refused to write the assembly.

files.description: Every file read: the source and each library text.

path.description: The path as the compilation read it.

role.description: Source or library text. Source: The source file the compilation was asked to compile. Library: A library text a COPY statement read.

sha256.description: The lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the file's bytes as read.

inclusions.description: Every COPY statement processed, in text order.

items.description: One COPY statement and the library text it brought in.

parent.description: The inclusion whose library text holds the COPY statement, or null for the source.

depth.description: 1 for a COPY statement of the source, one more per library text it is nested in.

copyLine.description: The listing line the COPY word stands on.

copyLastLine.description: The listing line the statement ends on; the inclusion's lines follow it.

textName.description: The text-name or literal the statement names.

libraryName.description: The library-name or literal of its OF / IN phrase, or null.

file.description: The Id of the library text read, or null when none was.

outcome.description: Found, not found or circular. Found: The library text was found and copied. NotFound: No library text of that name was found; nothing was copied. Circular: The library text copies itself, directly or through others; it was not copied again.

suppress.description: The statement writes the SUPPRESS phrase: the library text it incorporates is not listed, and the statement itself is (§2023:7.2.3.4 GR4).

lines.description: The source section, in listing order: every physical line of every file read, each inclusion's lines after the last line of its COPY statement.

items.description: One physical line of the source section (DESIGN-listing.md section 4.2).

number.description: The listing line number, 1-based, unique in the document.

file.description: The Id the line is read from.

fileLine.description: The 1-based physical line of that file.

inclusion.description: The Id the line belongs to; null for the source.

depth.description: The inclusion depth, 0 for the source.

form.description: Fixed or free form. Fixed: Fixed-form reference format: sequence area, indicator area, areas A and B, identification area. Free: Free-form reference format.

kind.description: What the line is. Source: A line of program text. Comment: A comment line: the fixed-form * indicator, or the floating comment indicator. PageEjectComment: A comment line with the fixed-form slant (/) indicator, which ejects a page before it is listed. DebuggingLine: A debugging line: the fixed-form D indicator, or the floating >>D indicator. Continuation: A fixed-form continuation line (the hyphen indicator). Directive: A compiler directive line, where the edition has compiler directives. CommentEntry: A line of the comment-entry of an IDENTIFICATION DIVISION paragraph such as AUTHOR or DATE-COMPILED. CcvsExcluded: A line the NIST CCVS column-7 conventions exclude (the --nist dialect only). NotAnIndicator: A line whose indicator area holds a character that is no indicator, read as program text. Blank: A blank line: nothing but spaces in its program text.

text.description: The physical text as the file holds it, tabs expanded.

omitted.description: A false conditional-compilation branch omitted the line.

listed.description: The visibility pass's answer: the text renderer prints it.

pageBreakBefore.description: The visibility pass's answer: a page starts before it.

program.description: The Id of the innermost program containing the line.

replacement.description: Which replacement the compiler made of the line, if any. None: The line was compiled as written. DateCompiled: The first line of a DATE-COMPILED paragraph, whose paragraph "is replaced during compilation with a paragraph of the form" DATE-COMPILED. current date. (§1985:VI.3.4.4 GR1): the listing prints the replacement in its place. DateCompiledEntry: A further line of the comment-entry of a replaced DATE-COMPILED paragraph: replaced with the paragraph, so the text listing does not print it (the model keeps the written text). Replacing: A replacing action of a REPLACE statement or of a COPY statement's REPLACING phrase matched text that begins on the line, so what was compiled is not what was written: the text listing prints the line as written, marked 'R', and under it the compiled text.

replaced.description: What the compiler compiled in place of Text: DATE-COMPILED's replacement, printed in its place; or, for a line a replacing action changed, the resultant text compiled from it (one line of text per resultant line, joined by line feeds; empty when the replacement removed everything the line held), printed under it.

diagnostics.description: The Id of each diagnostic placed on the line, in listing order.

programs.description: Every source unit, in text order, with its nesting and listing line range.

items.description: One source unit of the compilation group (DESIGN-listing.md section 6.5).

name.description: The name its identification paragraph declares, as written.

kind.description: Program, function, class, ... Program: A program. Function: A user-defined function. Class: A class definition. Interface: An interface definition. Factory: The factory definition of a class. Object: The object (instance) definition of a class. Method: A method definition.

parent.description: The Id of the unit that directly contains it, or null.

firstLine.description: The first listing line of the unit.

lastLine.description: The last listing line of the unit.

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic the compilation reported of its source, in listing order: those placed on a line by line and column, then those placed on none in the order they were reported.

items.description: One diagnostic of the compilation (DESIGN-listing.md section 6.3), placed on the listing line it names.

severity.description: Error, warning or information. Error: An error: the compilation fails. Warning: A warning: the compilation does not fail. Info: Information.

message.description: The diagnostic's text, which names the rule of the edition in force where it cites one.

line.description: The listing line the diagnostic is placed on, or null when it names no place in a file the listing lists (a diagnostic about the compilation as a whole, or about text the compiler generated).

file.description: The Id of the file it names, or null when Line is.

fileLine.description: The 1-based physical line of that file, or null when Line is.

column.description: The 1-based character position in that line's text (Text, tabs expanded), or null when Line is.

citations.description: Each citation of the standard the message makes, in the order written.

items.description: One citation of a COBOL standard a diagnostic's message makes, in the repository's citation format §<edition>:<locator>[ <rule>] (§2023:13.18.40.3 SR14, §1985:VI.5.3.4 GR3).

edition.description: The edition's year as the format writes it: 2023, 2014, 2002 or 1985 for the standards, 1989 and 1993 for the two amendments of the 1985 standard.

locator.description: The clause, or for 1985 the Roman section and paragraph (VI.5.3.4) or printed page (p.VI-20).

rule.description: The rule within the clause (GR1, SR14, RV3, Format 10), or null when none is named.

displays.description: Every transfer of a DISPLAY directive to the listing, in the order the directives were processed.

items.description: One transfer of a DISPLAY directive to the listing (§2023:7.3.12.4 GR1, GR5 a), GR6; DESIGN-listing.md section 6.10): printed at its directive's place whether or not a LISTING directive suppresses that line (GR2).

line.description: The listing line of the DISPLAY directive.

text.description: The data transferred: each operand's image, in the order written, separated by one space.

options.description: The options section: every option of the compilation with its value and whether it is the default, then the compiler and the host it ran on; empty when the section was not asked for.

items.description: One row of the options section (DESIGN-listing.md section 6.4).

name.description: The option as the command line spells it (--std), or the name of the fact (source, compiler).

value.description: Its value, as the command line spells it where it has a spelling; for a default that is derived from another value (the output path), the value derived.

origin.description: Default, specified, or a fact of the compiler or the host. Default: An option the compilation was not given a value for: its default. Specified: An option given a value other than its default. Host: No option: a fact of the compiler or of the host the compilation ran on (a version, the operating system).

statistics.description: The statistics section: lines by kind and by file, programs, statements, diagnostics by severity and the verbs; null when the section was not asked for.

lines.description: Every line of the listing, counted.

kinds.description: The lines of each kind, every kind once, in the order of ListingLineKind.

kind.description: The kind. Source: A line of program text. Comment: A comment line: the fixed-form * indicator, or the floating comment indicator. PageEjectComment: A comment line with the fixed-form slant (/) indicator, which ejects a page before it is listed. DebuggingLine: A debugging line: the fixed-form D indicator, or the floating >>D indicator. Continuation: A fixed-form continuation line (the hyphen indicator). Directive: A compiler directive line, where the edition has compiler directives. CommentEntry: A line of the comment-entry of an IDENTIFICATION DIVISION paragraph such as AUTHOR or DATE-COMPILED. CcvsExcluded: A line the NIST CCVS column-7 conventions exclude (the --nist dialect only). NotAnIndicator: A line whose indicator area holds a character that is no indicator, read as program text. Blank: A blank line: nothing but spaces in its program text.

omitted.description: The lines a false conditional-compilation branch omitted (Omitted).

copied.description: The lines of library text a COPY statement copied (Inclusion set).

unlisted.description: The lines the source section does not print (Listed false): a LISTING directive or COPY SUPPRESS suppressed them.

files.description: The lines of each file read, counted, in the order of the files: a library text copied twice counts each copy.

lines.description: Its lines, counted: each listing line read from the file, so each inclusion of a library text counts.

kinds.description: The lines of each kind, every kind once, in the order of ListingLineKind.

omitted.description: The lines a false conditional-compilation branch omitted (Omitted).

copied.description: The lines of library text a COPY statement copied (Inclusion set).

unlisted.description: The lines the source section does not print (Listed false): a LISTING directive or COPY SUPPRESS suppressed them.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics the compilation reported, counted by severity, every severity once.

severity.description: The severity. Error: An error: the compilation fails. Warning: A warning: the compilation does not fail. Info: Information.

parse.description: The programs, statements and verbs the parse read, or null when the source was not parsed.

programs.description: The source units of the program map (Programs).

statements.description: The statements, a statement nested in another counted as well.

verbs.description: Each verb, by the word that begins its statements, in the ordinal order of that word.

items.description: One verb of the verb counts (IBM's VBREF).

verb.description: The word that begins the statements, in upper case (MOVE, GO, NEXT).

lines.description: The listing line each of those statements begins on, in listing order, one entry per statement (a line that begins two of them appears twice); a statement on no line the listing holds has none.

sections.description: Each section the listing was asked for, in the order of ListingSection: produced, or why not (DESIGN-listing.md section 4.3). A section not asked for has no entry and its part of the document is empty: the lines and the DISPLAY transfers are the source section's, the diagnostics the diagnostics section's. The header, the files, the inclusions and the programs are always present, since the lines and every page heading refer to them.

items.description: Whether a section was produced and, when not, why (DESIGN-listing.md section 4.3): a section is never left out silently.

section.description: The section. Source: The source section: every physical line of every file read, with the DISPLAY directive's transfers. Programs: The program map: every source unit, its nesting and its listing lines. Diagnostics: The diagnostics: each at its line in the source section, and all of them in the summary at the end. Options: The options in effect: every option with its value and whether it is the default, the compiler and the host. Statistics: The statistics: lines by kind and by file, programs, statements, diagnostics by severity, and each verb with its count and its lines.

produced.description: Whether the listing holds the section.

reason.description: Why the section was not produced (the phase that stopped it), or null when it was.
